requirements.text: Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field plus one year of progressively responsible experience in the job offered or a related occupation.
1\. Experience designing and developing large\-scale software applications using Object\-Oriented Design and Java (1 year)
2\. Experience building scalable and secure RESTful APIs with Java Spring Boot Programming (1 year)
3\. Experience with microservices and distributed system architecture (1 year)
4\. Experience with establishing automation, CI/CD pipelines, and release management using various systems and Jenkins scripting (1 year)
5\. Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, MongoDB, Redis caching with fallback mechanisms, and Hibernate/JPA optimistic locking (1 year)
6\. Experience with serverless event\-driven architectures with auto\-scaling, deploying, and managing applications on Cloud AWS (1 year)
7\. Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes (1 year)
8\. Experience with comprehensive testing strategies including unit testing with JUnit and Mockito (1 year)
9\. Experience with monitoring and observability tools including Datadog, CloudWatch, and ELK stack for centralized logging and proactive performance monitoring (1 year)
Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship
